cells.gaps: Whether the 12 selected communes of 77 were equipped and went live is not established: the one source, of September 2019, says they were to be equipped during 2019/2020. Nothing is dated since, so governance and the last twelve months hold nothing; the partner ownership and donor finance of 2019 fall outside the 36 months.
cells.note: Twelve communes selected for cash-desk software is a pilot, and no fact says it ran past selection. Stage 3 needs a system past its pilot and live in communes outside the capital.
